scope: CPU-only offline diagnostic on existing leaves train assets. No training, inference, rendering or reliability module.

input_roots.anchors: Explicit leaves training anchor cache only
input_roots.priors: Explicit leaves cached prior directory only

forbidden: all evaluation caches and metrics.json, including train subdirectories beneath evaluation roots
full original execution manifests that mix train and test paths

grouped_cv.groups: Cached point_ids; same 3D point assigned the same fold across all three views. No pixel-level random split.
grouped_cv.fit: Per image/fold, unweighted float64 affine OLS from cached raw_inverse_depth sampled with the frozen OpenCV INTER_LINEAR rule to non-held-out positive inverse_z anchors.
grouped_cv.failure_policy: Keep fold assignment fixed; preserve every failed/unsupported fold and its counts/reason. No refold, fallback, point removal or positive-prediction clipping. Incomplete CV is labeled incomplete.
grouped_cv.prediction: Only raw_inverse_depth and fit-fold OLS parameters. Cached inverse_z/valid/full-fit parameters never filter or define held-out predictions.
grouped_cv.normalizer: Median inverse_z of fit-fold anchors only.
grouped_cv.error: abs(a_fit*raw_sample+b_fit-held_inverse_z)/fit_median_inverse_z; retain finite nonpositive predictions as errors and separately flag them.
grouped_cv.optimism_comparator: Full-data OLS evaluated on the exact same held anchors and divided by the same fit-fold median; explicitly in-sample, not independent truth.
grouped_cv.aggregation: Per fold counts/mean/median/p90 then per-image pooled out-of-fold anchor means/median/p90, no duplicated point-level significance claims.

full_fit_reproduction.policy: Compare a separate full-data reproduction against existing manifest metadata; do not use those full-data parameters or masks in cross-fit prediction.

coverage.full_maps: Every full-image pixel distance to nearest existing anchor; record full-image and cached-prior-valid denominators separately, excluded pixels never set to zero.
coverage.held_anchor_support: Distance/count support from fit-fold anchors only; exclude held point IDs before computing support.
coverage.bin_intervals: Left-inclusive right-exclusive; last bin includes all finite distances >=0.1. These are descriptive bins, not reliability thresholds.
coverage.association: Per-image out-of-fold and per-fold Spearman rank correlation (average ranks) between support distance and normalized held-out residual; constant/insufficient data is unavailable. No p-values, confidence intervals or pooled pixel significance.
coverage.tile_error_failure_policy: Fewer than 5 out-of-fold residual observations: error unavailable, count and support still reported. Zero-anchor tiles are unobserved, not known failures.
coverage.tie_and_constant_policy: Average ranks for ties; if fewer than five finite pairs or zero rank variance, mark unavailable with reason, not zero correlation.

hypotheses.H1: Out-of-fold alignment residual may exceed full-fit residual on the same anchors; compare signed differences in all three train views without threshold tuning.
hypotheses.H2: Larger fit-anchor support distance may associate with larger out-of-fold residual; report all view/fold directions including opposite/undefined results.
hypotheses.H3: Low fitted residual may coexist with low spatial support. Report all 108 tiles per view, including zero-anchor tiles and no-error-observation tiles; unknown is not failure.

acceptance.engineering: Exact input/source provenance, train-only access record, 15 fold records with all unsupported/failed statuses, complete coverage counts and formula/aggregation checks. Engineering does not require H1/H2/H3 to hold.
acceptance.research: Proxy-level descriptive evidence only, no independent dense depth truth or universal reliability score. No automatic authorization for masks, weighting, training or other scenes.
acceptance.if_hypotheses_fail: Report null/opposite/unsupported outcomes. Do not search folds, thresholds, views or scenes. Stop and recommend next step.

resources.device: CPU only, no CUDA initialization or GPU processes
resources.policy: Measure actual wall/peak RSS, stop and preserve anomalies; no silent subsampling, resolution/bins/precision changes.

outputs: 15 fold rows and all per-anchor OOF/full-fit comparator residuals
324 tile rows with support and observation counts
three train-only RGB/anchor/support/sparse OOF-residual overlays; no dense error map or reliability labels
all failed/undefined cases and measured CPU resources
concise limitations and acceptance report; raw arrays stay outside Git
not_executed_this_step: No residual, fold membership, coverage or correlation computed
No model load, training, inference, rendering or new test evaluation
Only existing source/schema and 14 training-only file existence/size/SHA256 inspected

runtime_entry_contract.input_decode: Allowlisted bytes only; NumPy allow_pickle=False, image decode from memory
runtime_entry_contract.run_repetition: Exactly one approved complete run; retain failed outputs and obtain a new reviewed scope before changing plan or retrying with altered settings.
